question: According to the principle of superposition, the net electrostatic potential at a point due to a system of discrete charges is calculated as the:

options.A: Vector sum of the potentials due to individual charges.
options.B: Algebraic sum of the potentials due to individual charges.
options.C: Product of the potentials due to individual charges.
options.D: Average of the potentials due to individual charges.
